verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a community thread. A user complains that gstack collects telemetry on usage data, and a reply notes that you can opt out, which suggests gstack itself offers an opt-out. No first-party documentation describes the mechanism, and the backdoor worry is general skepticism rather than contradicting evidence. Missing for 10: first-party docs on what telemetry is collected, the documented opt-out mechanism (env var, config or command), confirmation that opt-out stops all tracking, and hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: A reply noted you can opt out of it.
